title: Private bounded argv execution qualification
objective: Qualify a provider-internal Windows executor for deterministic argv-based child execution with AppContainer identity, kill-on-close Job lifecycle, scrubbed environment, bounded stdout/stderr, timeout cancellation, and verified process-tree quiescence, without exposing process.spawn through policy, cotrad, or MCP.

include: explicit absolute executable and argv validation
AppContainer suspended launch and token verification
Job assignment and membership before resume
closed stdin and bounded stdout/stderr capture
timeout cancellation with verified Job quiescence
typed provider result and failure evidence
exclude: workspace grants beyond an explicit qualification root

authority_delta.filesystem: Qualification-only explicit temporary root; no configured workspace grant
authority_delta.process: Private test-only provider executor; no external or MCP process authority
authority_delta.secrets: Fixed environment allowlist; no Cotra/tunnel secret inheritance

invariants: The executor is unreachable from policy, cotrad, and MCP
The executable is an explicitly validated absolute path and argv is passed without shell interpolation
The child is created suspended in a zero-capability AppContainer
The scrubbed environment excludes Cotra, tunnel, generic secret, and arbitrary caller variables
No inheritable handles or stdin input are passed to the child
Job membership and AppContainer token are verified before resume
stdout and stderr are independently bounded and over-limit termination is verified
Timeout cancellation terminates the Job and returns PROCESS_TIMEOUT only after quiescence is verified
All failure paths close handles and remove temporary profiles/qualification resources

acceptance.claim: Native Windows tests launch a deterministic qualification child with argv and return bounded stdout/stderr and exit code.
Native tests reject malformed argv, non-absolute executables, and invalid cwd/environment inputs.
Native tests prove no sensitive environment values and no inherited handles reach the child.
Native timeout test terminates a descendant tree and verifies zero active Job processes before returning typed timeout evidence.
Native output-limit tests terminate and verify quiescence without returning success.
Non-Windows builds remain cfg-isolated and existing policy continues denying process.spawn.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, Jev, and OCR gates pass.

done_when: The private bounded executor and native qualification are merged with post-merge verification; no external EXECUTE authority is exposed.
